title: Palimpsestus OS: Open Specification for a Scale-Invariant Topological Field Architecture
description: Foundational technical specification for Palimpsestus OS, detailing the 4x4 matrix (CC, CL, CP, CI, LC, LL, LP, LI, PC, PL), non-equilibrium graph mechanics, 64 autonomic reaction gates, and path-derived topological security.
